text:
maria: heads-up — starting onboarding for Helios-17B-mqa-v2. weights pushed to s3://redwood-models/helios/17b/mqa-v2/ and config draft attached. asking for quick smoke: weights path sanity, tokenizer quirks, and runtime flags (RoPE/GQA/MQA, sliding-window).

kai: looking now. quick note: tokenizer file is sentencepiece but the model metadata lists `bos_id: 1` while our runtime expects 0 for BOS. could cause shifted logits. did the exporter intentionally re-index? @maria

maria: no, exporter was a forked script from Zephyr — probably why. i'll update the metadata if that's the only change.

devon: weights path missing `index.json` for sharded checkpoints — CI complained when trying to assemble shards. path check: `ls s3://redwood-models/helios/17b/mqa-v2/` showed shards but no index. i can generate one if you want me to upload.

maria: please yes — that would unblock the smoke run. thanks.

priya: raising a config question — our default RoPE scaling strategy for MQA/GQA models is `rope_scaling: dynamic` which uses token_len histogram to pick scale. Helios has long-context training; i'd prefer `rope_scaling: fixed:1.0` for the first canary to avoid latent drift. also: attention_impl set to `flash_attn` in the YAML but we need a fallback to `kv_cache_attn` for older GPUs. here's a minimal snippet i'm proposing:

```yaml
model: helios-17b-mqa-v2
weights: s3://redwood-models/helios/17b/mqa-v2/
tokenizer: sentencepiece.model
rope_scaling: fixed
rope_scale_value: 1.0
attention_impls:
  - flash_attn
  - kv_cache_attn
mqa: true
gqa: true
sliding_window: auto
```

ryan: also watch head mapping — Helios uses interleaved heads for MQA (grouped by 2). runtime mapping needs `mqa_head_groups: 2` or you'll get head dim mismatch during init. small snippet from runtime config: `mqa: { enabled: true, head_groups: 2 }`. without this we fall back to single-head-per-head which explodes memory.

kai: tokenizer fix command i ran locally: `python tools/tokenizer_tool.py --repair-bos --model s3://redwood-models/helios/17b/mqa-v2/tokenizer.model --set-bos 0` — we should add a CI lint that fails if tokenizer.bos != 0 for sentencepiece models.

infra-bot: onboard-smoke job queued: `onboard-smoke-2250001000`. logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/2250001000 (will post results here).

devon: i've generated `index.json` and uploaded as `index-v1.json` then moved to `index.json` after checksum. md5: abc123... changed permissions to `r:public-read` for the smoke job.

maria: awesome — i'm updating the YAML with Priya's suggestions + Ryan's head_groups, and will patch tokenizer metadata. will kick the canary once infra-bot reports green. thanks all :thumbsup:

ryan: small test to run once canary is up: run `python tools/serve_smoke.py --model helios-17b-mqa-v2 --seq-len 2048 --batch 1 --test-threads 2` and confirm output deterministic on same prompt (to catch RoPE misalignment).

maria: noted. planning to schedule the canary for tonight 10pm PT. i'll post results here.

infra-bot: onboard-smoke-2250001000 started on runner `g4dn-canary-12`. logs streaming: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/2250001000/logs

maria: thanks — closing initial coordination loop. ping me directly if you see any failing checks.

kai: will follow up with a tiny PR to add the tokenizer BOS lint.

maria: appreciated. closing thread after smoke completes. :rocket:
